book.name: 1 Ukorinti
book.title: Ubvur uwu inggbaashia Uburhu aka atsɛnge abi Ukorinti

content: Awɛrhi itser ri itser Unum
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umum isi idɛ̃ɛ̃ irherhuwamum umbi arherhe ru nyaka abirabɛ Ipfu iki idarh umbɔ, bɔr ru nyaka anera ru upfung, írheng awɛkaci ru Ukiristo.
Umum ikũ abɛ̃ ifuka umbi, umum isi ikũmum ubingha ukpuku ukpukpɔma, umbi anasi imɛ̃mbi igha ukpɔ. Idzidzɛrhe umbi anasi imɛ̃mbi.
Umbi ana awu abirabɛ ayormbi iki idarh umbi. Umbi ana awembi ru unyɛ̃ɛ̃ nu uning ru umbi, umbi asi iwembi abirabɛ ayormbi iki idarh umbi? Umbi asi itɔ̃mbi ikpũ itser ru nyaka abi upfung?
Ivang uwɔɔ aka igɔr agɛ, <<Umum idɔsu Uburhu,>> uwɔɔ ikɛi agɔr agɛ, <<Umum idɔsu Uaforho,>> umbi asi iwembi ru nyaka abi upfung?
Ungamɔ awu Uaforho? Ungamɔ awu Uburhu? Umbɔ awe agãrhã ukpekũ, abirabɛ umbi aka adzowe imangmang ru ubokmbɔ. Ru ubɛn unera atɔ̃ itseryɛ Uteijee aka adzowe unga.
Umum idoi ikpũa, Uaforho atsuyi amɛ̃, bɔr awu Unum atsu ikpũ hã imɛr iseng.
Nggee asi iwea unga uwuku ududoi use unga uwuku utsuyi amɛ̃ awe ubin, awu Unum ukpekũ, uwuruwi aka atsu ikpũa imɛr iseng.
Uner uwuku ududoi nu uwuku utsuyi amɛ̃ ifosambɔ iwu unying, nu ubɛn unera awuri ikpoa itosanga ri itseryɛ unga aka atɔ̃.
Umɛn iwu awɛrhi itser ri itser Unum, umbi awu icang Unum, nu idzin Unum.
Awe ri imimuta Unum aka adzaa umum, umum itsu atarh idzin ugɛɛ uner uwuku uhwɛng idzin, nu uwɔɔ adzin nu ake. Bɔr ubɛn unera angwɛ̃dzɛn na adzin nu ake.
Unera asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ atsuka atarh idzin akɔɔ aka anangke akirakɛ umbɔ aka agbaashia atsu, ake awu Uyesu Ukiristo.
Unera aba akũ uzinarhi, uazurhfa, atarh imang, acucii, ubĩĩ use agam adzin ra atarh idzin hã,
unuma ubɛn unera awuri inyã ikpũ itseryɛ unga aka atɔ̃. Ivang Uyesu aka ibvui aba, unga awuri itsu anera ahwɛng ake. Awuri ivira ngge nggu urha nu urha ha iwuri iviri ikpũ itser ubɛn unera.
Ubinkpi unga aka adzin nu atarh ha uba usi ikpĩĩkpɔ, uner idzin hã awuri ikpoa itosanga.
Idzin hã iba ikpĩĩngge, itser uner idzin hã awuri igbabĩ, unga nibikanga awuri ikpoa ififɔrh, bɔr awuri iwe ru nyaku uner uwuku udzeki ikon urha.
Umbi asi ihwɛngmbi ugɛ umbi awu Iya-Num nu Ipfu-Num isei ru umbi?
Unera aba adakuka Iya-Num, Unum awuri idakuwe unga, ubinkutsu Iya-Num iwu isarsatake, ikɛi umbi awu Iya-Num hã.
Niba arhɛmmbi atsimbi. Unera aba akaifɛrhkɔ ugɛ unga asarasu icɛrɛ ru udan ukpirɛ, imɛ̃ngge unga adzipa awe ugugge ngge itsú unga asarasu.
Ubinkutsu isarasu upfung ukpirɛ iwu ugugge ra asu Unum. Ru nyaku itsɛng Arherhu-Num iki igɔr ugɛ,

content.text: <<Unga aka isaka adzui abi isarasu ri itsoimbɔ.>>

content: Ikɛi itsɛng igɔr igɛ, <<Uteijee ahwɛnga ugɛ ifɛrhkɔ abi itsoi iwu ibɛm.>>
Nggee, unera niba akũ uner afĩrhũnga! Abina kishoo awu akimbi,
Uburhu, use Uaforho, use Ukefa, use upfung, use urhɛ, use akpe, use abin aki icɛrɛ, use aki unuma, kishoo awu akimbi,
umbi awu abi Ukiristo, Ukiristo ikɛi awu uwu Unum.
